author: Oak Tree Comics
title: Hiring artist for picture book
content: WE'RE HIRING ARTISTS! Oak Tree Comics is looking to hire an artist for a picture book. The envisioned drawing style blends modern comic book imagery with the warmth and kindness of a classic picture book. Thematically, the story explores urban wildlife coexistence through humor and lots of heart. Anyone! Applicants should have a portfolio of picture book, comics, or sequential art that exhibits why they are a good fit for the position. For full submission guidelines, please visit the link in our bio.

author: willai3213
title: Seeking designer for exhibition character visuals
content: [徵｜展覽平面設計專案合作] Preparing an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Looking for a collaborator for visual design. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition materials. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Seeking exhibition/graphic design experience with a hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
